title: Assessment of Oxidative Phosphorylation and Glycolysis in NK Cells
author: Philippa R Kennedy
materials: NK cells are resuspended in Seahorse XF Assay Medium and added to a 96 well or 24 well flat bottom plate that has been coated with 0.01% poly-L-Lysine solution (Millipore Sigma) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

The extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) and the oxygen consumption rate (OCR) are measured (pmoles/min) in real time in an XFe96 analyzer after injection of drugs in the specified order. e.g. Mito Stress Test kit (10 mM glucose, 1 μM oligomycin then 1 μM FCCP plus 1mM sodium pyruvate then 0.5 μM rotenone/antimycin A; Cat. No. 103015-100) Glycolytic rate assay kit (0.5μM rotenone/antimycin A then 50mM 2-DG; Cat. No. 103344-100) ATP Rate Assay kit (1μM oligomycin then 0.5μM rotenone/antimycin A; Cat. No. 103592-100; all Agilent Technologies)

NK cells are resuspended in Seahorse XF Assay Medium and added to a 96 well or 24 well flat bottom plate that has been coated with 0.01% poly-L-Lysine solution (Millipore Sigma) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Hydrate sensor cartridge (day before)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL sterile water to each well of the Seahorse utility plate to hydrate the sensor cartridge.

steps.title: Prepare calibrant and incubate cartridge
steps.instruction: Aliquot Seahorse calibrant into a 50 mL conical tube, place both the cartridge and the calibrant tube at 37 °C in a non‑CO₂ incubator and leave overnight.

steps.title: Replace water with calibrant (day of)
steps.instruction: Remove the sterile water from the utility plate and add 200 µL Seahorse calibrant to each well, then return the plate to the non‑CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Wash NK cells
steps.instruction: Wash NK cells twice: first with PBS, then with Seahorse XF Assay medium (Agilent Technologies).

steps.title: Plate cells at appropriate density
steps.instruction: Add 500,000 cells per well to a 96‑well plate or 1 × 10⁶ cells per well to a 24‑well plate using Seahorse XF Assay medium.

steps.title: Centrifuge plate to adhere cells
steps.instruction: Spin the plate at 40 g (≈500 RPM) for 4 min, rotate the plate 180°, then spin again at 80 g (≈700 RPM) for 4 min without brake to promote cell adherence.

steps.title: Verify even cell distribution
steps.instruction: Inspect the plate under a microscope to ensure even plating of cells.

steps.title: Adjust assay medium pH
steps.instruction: Confirm that the Seahorse XF Assay medium is at pH 7.4 before proceeding.

steps.title: Prepare injection drugs
steps.instruction: Prepare the required drugs for injection ports; add 25 µL per port for a 96‑well assay or 75 µL per port for a 24‑well assay.

steps.title: Load drugs and incubate plate
steps.instruction: Load the prepared drug volumes into the appropriate injection ports of the Seahorse cartridge, then place the cell plate in the non‑CO₂ incubator while completing drug preparation.
